jordan (acct-cust): Hi, after the model upgrade this morning to rdx-llama3-14b-v2 our structured JSON responses are frequently invalid; our parser fails with 'Unexpected token' on second line. Happening on ~12% of calls.

maria (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste a failing response and your request payload? also a call_id if available.

jordan (acct-cust): request:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rdx-llama3-14b-v2",
  "prompt": "Return JSON with keys: items -> list of {id, name}",
  "json_mode": true,
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```
response (truncated):
```
{"items":[{"id":1,"name":"alpha"},{"id":2,"name":"beta"}],}

Additional analysis: The confidence looks low on item 2.\n

jordan (acct-cust): call_id: cid_2026_ABC123

maria (support): thanks. looks like there's a trailing comma after items array — server should enforce valid JSON. could you confirm if this only started after the rollout timestamp 1824009000?

andrew (eng-runtime): pinging eng-ml. we saw a canary push yesterday. need model artifact id and quant flag from request headers.

sophia (eng-ml): likely root cause: new instruction-tuning variant includes short human commentary appended after generation when model is uncertain. that can result in extra text after JSON or rewriter adding commas. do we have sample where commentary is inside JSON body (not just after)?

jordan (acct-cust): yes, we have some where model inserts a trailing comma and sometimes appends "\nNote: this may be incomplete" after the JSON which breaks strict parsers.

maria (support): repro steps for us:
1) use same call_id pattern and model param
2) set json_mode true and strict_parsing true (customer uses strict) 
3) repeat until fail (we hit failure ~1/10)

andrew (eng-runtime): can we surface a quick mitigation? we can add server-side post-process that attempts to find last matching brace and cut extra text, but that's brittle. alternative: enforce model-prescribed delimiter via streaming (send EOT token) or reject model variant.

sophia (eng-ml): immediate plan: roll the model variant back from rdx-llama3-14b-v2 to rdx-llama3-14b-v1 for customers with strict_parsing enabled until we patch the instruction-tuning artifact. long term: add extra training/regression tests to prevent appended commentary and a filter that validates JSON output before returning to customers.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for customer segment 'strict-parsing' at 1824012380 by automation.

maria (support): Jordan — we are rolling back for strict-parsing customers now. can you confirm if you want full rollback for your org or keep on dedicated rollback?

jordan (acct-cust): please rollback for our org; we rely on strict parsers. thanks.

andrew (eng-runtime): logged issue INF-1892. ETA for patch: 48 hours. we'll keep this thread updated and attach reproducer set.

sophia (eng-ml): adding regression test in eval harness: prompt set + strict_json check + sampling seeds to catch commentary append.

maria (support): summary: found model-output formatting regression after model upgrade; initiated targeted rollback for affected orgs; eng teams working on fix and tests. I'll update when rollback completes and when patch lands.

jordan (acct-cust): confirmed rollback fixed the issue for our last 50 calls. thanks all :white_check_mark:

maria (support): closing for now, re-open if you see further failures.
